title: Where π₀.₅'s value noise comes from
question: Is the jitter in π₀.₅ value models already in its image features, added by its language-model layers, or added by fine-tuning?
verdict: Frozen π₀.₅ SigLIP is as steady as an ImageNet ResNet (head SNR 0.172 vs 0.168, 825 episodes); robot training did not make the vision features noisy.
Two separate drops, each about halving head SNR: the frozen language-model layers (0.122 → 0.059) and SigLIP fine-tuning (0.172 → 0.084).
Layout variety, not episode count: at 375 episodes, fresh layouts give SigLIP 0.194 vs 0.122 on the fixed layouts.
